commits.author: 888newstep
commits.message:
security: harden auth, evaluation, upload and JWT handling

- Add local non-destructive security probe (localhost-only, no credential reading)
- Sandbox evaluation dataset paths with toRealPath() and size/case budgets
- Bound topKs and reject oversized/NaN input
- Use constant-time comparison for admin API key
- Add JWT issuer/audience validation on generation and parsing
- Limit concurrent evaluation runs with a semaphore
- Reject empty/oversized uploads at servlet and service layers
- Validate PDF/DOCX magic bytes on document upload
- Document the attack surface audit and hardening measures

commits.author: codeAnqiang-ma
commits.message:
fix: 会话摘要触发改用累计消息计数，与滑动窗口解耦

滑动窗口会把 messages.size() 截断到固定上限，窗口填满后
"每 N 条消息生成一次摘要"退化为常量条件：默认配置（10/5）下
每条消息都触发一次摘要 LLM 调用，间隔不整除窗口时摘要永久停止。
改为基于 Redis 原子自增的累计消息计数取模，并在 clearSession
中一并清理计数 key，摘要条目的 round 字段恢复为真实轮次。

Fixes #1

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commits.author: 888newstep
commits.message:
fix: make bm25 an independent corpus recall path

- Add VectorStoreService.fetchAllChunks and implement it in the QA adapter
  (Milvus query) and in-memory store; LangChain4j store degrades gracefully.
- MultiRecallService now builds a TTL-cached BM25 index over the full corpus
  and fuses it with the vector Top-20 via RRF, instead of re-ranking only the
  vector candidate pool. Falls back to candidate-pool BM25 when the corpus is
  unavailable.
- Switch Chinese tokenization from single characters to overlapping bigrams
  to reduce over-matching and improve lexical precision.
- Update MultiRecallServiceTest for the independent recall path.
